name: Puertollano (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of dark red, white and dark red, charged in the upper hoist with a yellow royal crown.
history: The council of Puertollano resolved to adopt the municipal flag in plenary on 24 November 2022 and it was granted by Order 67/2023 of 22 March of the Consejería de Hacienda y Administraciones Públicas; it is a rectangular flag of 2:3 divided horizontally into three equal stripes, red, white and red.

features.role: royal crown in the upper hoist
